notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.content:
Hey Strikers! Your New Update is Here!
You asked, we listened! The latest update for the Hyperspace Striker Demo is live, and it's a big one. Get ready to kick back and play from the couch, because full controller support has arrived!

Check out what's new:



🎮 Full Controller Support is LIVE!



That's right! Plug in your favorite controller and enjoy full ship control and UI navigation. We're already working on future improvements like rumble and other cool features to make it feel even better.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/d6aff0009a2bbb897f679b4bcd4995e51f83dfde.png"]

Here's the control scheme:

LT: Fire Energy Weapons (Hold to charge!)

RT: Fire Main Weapons

LB: Drop Mines

RB: Fire Rockets

Left Stick: Movement & Menu Navigation

Right Stick: Scroll through menus (Hangar, etc.)

A Button: Select / Confirm

B Button: Dash (in-game) / Back (in-menu, hold to go back a screen)

X Button: Start Reload Minigame

Start: Pause



🔧 Stuff We Fixed (Bug Squashing!)



Enemy bullets will no longer blow each other up right out of the barrel.

The "Retry (Keep Loadout)" button won't lock you out of the menu anymore if you're broke. It will now properly check your credits first.

The cost for "Retry (Keep Loadout)" will now correctly show how much it increases each time you use it.

Your loadout now correctly resets when you go back to the Ship Selection screen.

Cleaned out some old scripts related to a "boost" system that no longer exists.



✨ Making Life Easier (QoL)



The game is now smart enough to know if you're using a controller or M+K and will swap the controls for you on the fly.

In menus, you can now tap B to jump to the 'Back' button or hold it to go to the previous screen instantly.



⚖️ Rebalancing the Arsenal



We've re-adjusted damage numbers for all weapons.

Mines are back! We've TRIPLED their damage to make them a seriously deadly build choice once again. Go blow some stuff up!
[hr][/hr]
Thanks for all your feedback, and happy flying!

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
As promised, we've solved several issues that were found since our last patch. Please give the game a try and let us know if you encounter any new problems.

Bug Fixes
Combo buffs no longer remain active after switching ships.

Retrying a level now correctly resets your build to the one you had at the start.

The mining beam no longer consumes power ammo or halt its regeneration.

Turret drones no longer use regular ammo or spend it on left-click.

Damage indicators now display as intended.

It's no longer possible to pause the game during events that have their own pause state, such as leveling up or viewing the demo splash screen.
New Feature
Upon game over, you now have the option to retry the level with your current build. Doing so will forfeit all credits earned during that run. The credit cost for this option will increase with each subsequent retry.

notes.title: HOTFIX: v0.02a
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a minor issue where the game saved your credit amount every time credits were collected. The game now saves after earning 100 credits, at game over, when pausing, upon leveling up, or after completing an enemy wave.

Resolved an issue where the advanced ship class did not include its full starting build. The missing Tier 1 engine upgrade now correctly appears in the build menu.

Fixed the demo timer not pausing with the game. It now tracks time in sync with the rest of the game, preventing the demo splash screen from appearing when the game is paused.

notes.title: Update Time!
notes.content:
No progress will be lost.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/16b721c49c924b54fd544b77270315abb49edcbf.png"]QoL ImprovementsHints and Tooltips
Multiple additions to every menu now include a small tooltip explaining the function of each section. These tooltips will appear on every new game launch and will be addressed in a future update, allowing players to turn them off or reset them.


Level Unlocked
The level-up menu now explains how to upgrade your ship's systems, making it easier for new players during their first run.


Menu Improvements
It’s now possible to return to the ship selection screen from the pause and game-over menus.


Ship unlocked
The ship selection screen now displays a notification whenever a new ship is unlocked.


New Builds
New ships come with preloaded tools and weapons suited to their class, making them easier to test immediately.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/6258e7d62d9b24c815ac845e08328141e8b9e837.png"]
More Upgrades
All ships now come with two slots to improve armor, engines, or add tools as intended. 


ImprovementsPerformance Improvements
Significant performance enhancements have been made. Changes to how multiple textures and animations are loaded have greatly increased game performance, reducing slowdowns when many enemies are on screen.


Better music performance
Music is now loaded upfront at the start of each run, preventing stuttering caused by loading new tracks mid-run.


Bug Fixes
Laser weapons no longer break when the game is paused at the wrong moment.

Tech slots on certain ship classes now appear correctly during gameplay.

The ship selection screen now properly displays newly unlocked ships on the first load.

Some menus no longer send players to the wrong screen or the title screen unintentionally.

Music no longer cuts off prematurely under certain conditions, such as game overs.

Smaller shockwaves no longer cause zero damage to surrounding objects.



End of transmission...
